Ram Charan's 'Peddi' Achieves Box Office Success, Sparks Family Anecdotes

Ram Charan's film 'Peddi' has achieved significant box office success, crossing ₹1800 crore globally according to some reports and ₹334.75 crore worldwide by day 23. Amidst the film's triumph, Charan shared personal anecdotes, including his daughter Klin Kaara's reaction to his role and his emotional response to the film's reception. The film's success has also led to international screenings and fan interactions.
